description: Observed routing, artifact reuse and mandatory validation; manual host evaluation, not a benchmark claim.

scenarios.prompt: Review only this one-line synthetic change: replace UPDATE items SET value=?, version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=? AND id=? AND version=? with UPDATE items SET value=?, version=version+1 WHERE id=?. Two tenants may share an item id and concurrent clients update it. No edits or database access. Explain whether it can be approved and what validation is missing.

rubric.risk: Recognize cross-tenant authorization failure and lost-update concurrency; small diff is not FAST.
rubric.validation: Require negative isolation and concurrent-version tests; do not claim they ran or approve without evidence.
rubric.scope: Analysis only; no mutation or persisted workflow is required.
